entries.title: Psalms 72:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of Solomon.>> Give the king Your judgments, O God, And Your righteousness to the king's Son.

entries.title: Psalms 72:2
segments: ¶He will judge Your people with righteousness, And Your poor with justice.

entries.title: Psalms 72:3
segments: The mountains will bring peace to the people, And the little hills, by righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 72:4
segments: He will bring justice to the poor of the people; He will save the children of the needy, And will break in pieces the oppressor.

entries.title: Psalms 72:5
segments: They shall fear You As long as the sun and moon endure, Throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 72:6
segments: He shall come down like rain upon the grass before mowing, Like showers [that] water the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:7
segments: In His days the righteous shall flourish, And abundance of peace, Until the moon is no more.

entries.title: Psalms 72:8
segments: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the River to the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:9
segments: Those who dwell in the wilderness will bow before Him, And His enemies will lick the dust.

entries.title: Psalms 72:10
segments: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles Will bring presents; The kings of Sheba and Seba Will offer gifts.

entries.title: Psalms 72:11
segments: Yes, all kings shall fall down before Him; All nations shall serve Him.

entries.title: Psalms 72:12
segments: For He will deliver the needy when he cries, The poor also, and [him] who has no helper.

entries.title: Psalms 72:13
segments: He will spare the poor and needy, And will save the souls of the needy.

entries.title: Psalms 72:14
segments: He will redeem their life from oppression and violence; And precious shall be their blood in His sight.

entries.title: Psalms 72:15
segments: And He shall live; And the gold of Sheba will be given to Him; Prayer also will be made for Him continually, [And] daily He shall be praised.

entries.title: Psalms 72:16
segments: There will be an abundance of grain in the earth, On the top of the mountains; Its fruit shall wave like Lebanon; And [those] of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:17
segments: His name shall endure forever; His name shall continue as long as the sun. And [men] shall be blessed in Him; All nations shall call Him blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 72:18
segments: ¶Blessed [be] the LORD God, the God of Israel, Who only does wondrous things!

entries.title: Psalms 72:19
segments: And blessed [be] His glorious name forever! And let the whole earth be filled [with] His glory. Amen and Amen.

entries.title: Psalms 72:20
segments: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
